decided_by: human annotator (visual), corroborated by a pixel-only source audit

violated_rule.predeclared: 300 continuous native-FPS frames, no camera/broadcast cut, >=10 mean humans/frame over the full window

discontinuity_in_the_window.transition_type: dissolve, not a hard cut -- the change is spread over ~17 frames, so no adjacent frame pair looks catastrophic and a lag-1 hard-cut rule sails past it

evidence.broadcast_clock_burn_in: src 391-393 read 29:0x; src 394 reads 30:35 -- a jump of about 1.5 minutes to a different game moment
evidence.pixel_signal: histogram correlation at lag 8 falls to 0.80-0.85 through the transition against a source median of 0.9987
evidence.visual: different attacking phase and camera position after the transition; frame 394 shows dissolve ghosting

discontinuity_in_the_window.note: Neither side reaches 300 frames, so this window cannot be salvaged by trimming.

source_verdict.finding: The Austin source video is a highlights/recap montage, not a continuous broadcast.
source_verdict.control: The same rule applied unchanged to the other three VAL sources found ZERO discontinuities in each (bayern, women_1, youth; 1501 frames each, hcorr p5 >= 0.9867).

clean_island_exists_but_not_used.why_not_used: Instructed not to hunt for a lucky clean island inside a generally discontinuous source. A window selected by surviving a cut detector calibrated on one event carries the risk that a slower dissolve was missed, and a benchmark whose windows were chosen by that search is only as trustworthy as the search.

annotation_work_preserved.identity_validity: INVALID AS CONTINUITY GT. The 16 tracks run unbroken across all 300 frames with no outside markers, so every identity was carried across the transition at package frames 103-119. No identity after the transition may be treated as continuous with one before it.

future_use.usable_for: measuring how a tracker behaves across an edit -- how many identities it destroys, whether it invents continuity that does not exist
future_use.not_usable_for: any clean-continuity metric, and never aggregated with the clean sequences
future_use.before_any_such_use: the pre-cut and post-cut segments must be re-annotated as two SEPARATE identity spaces; the current single-identity-space annotation asserts a continuity that the footage does not contain
